GH_SECTION_DESC: Search public GitHub repositories for a mod, or paste a direct HTTPS link. Downloads go to the inbox only; nothing touches the game folder unless you confirm the import, and that write is engine-gated.
GH_SEARCH_DESC: Public search, no account needed. About 60 requests per hour.
GH_NO_RESULTS: No repositories matched. Try different words.
GH_NO_RELEASES: This repository publishes no releases, so there is nothing to download here. Some popular mods live only on other sites; use the direct link field instead.
GH_ASSET_USABLE: A ZIP release asset. Downloads to the inbox first.
GH_ASSET_UNUSABLE: Not a ZIP asset, so it cannot be imported as a mod. Shown for completeness, not selectable.
GH_IMPORT_DESC: Downloads to the inbox, shows what it found, then asks before writing.
GH_DIRECT_DESC: Any HTTPS link to a ZIP. No trust anchor beyond the mod manifest inside, so the inspect step matters here.
GH_B_GATE: Writes stay blocked while another mod manager owns the Mods folder: remove its .mm_deployed marker and Mods_Core directory, migrate those mods, then retry. The blocked case is reported as E_EXTERNAL_MANAGER and is never bypassed.
CATALOG_SUB: Read-only directory. Planned games are catalog-only, not installable.
CATALOG_DETAIL_FOOTER: Display-only metadata. Listing a game here never enables installing mods for it.
TITLE_FILEDROP: Decky MOD Manager — Stardew Valley / SMAPI (detect-only)
TITLE_XML: Decky MOD Manager — RimWorld (MVP, selection A)
READ_ONLY_BANNER: READ-ONLY — an external mod manager owns this Mods folder. Install/Uninstall/Rollback are disabled to avoid damage.
TOAST_REFRESHED_BODY: Paths and state re-checked against disk.
REFRESH_DESC: Re-resolve paths, verify_on_open drift check, re-scan inbox.
INBOX_DESC: Browse with D-pad, A to preview/import, B to go back. Primary import path.
INBOX_FIXED: Fixed inbox only. No network, no Workshop.
HISTORY_DESC: Pick a transaction, confirm, roll back from snapshot / quarantine.
HISTORY_BODY: Uninstalled mod folders are restored, never deleted.
ERRORCODES_DESC: One code = one message; no traceback.
ERRORCODES_BODY: Code + log path are shown on every error.
CONSTRAINTS_BODY: Local ZIP + opt-in GitHub/HTTPS download to the inbox only · no Workshop · no .exe · no loader install · no launch-option or Proton-prefix edits · no root · read-only FS left on.
NO_MANAGED_MODS: This plugin has not installed any mod yet. Pre-existing mods on disk are listed under "Detected mods".
OSK_HINT: Optional: paste an absolute path to a local ZIP (Steam OSK). Skip this and use Inbox instead.
BADGES_TITLE: Info badges (NOT solved in this MVP):
DETAIL_SAME_UID_WARN: Already on disk as {dirs}: installing would create a second copy with the same UniqueID. Disable or uninstall that one first.
SUBTITLE_FD: For SMAPI this IS the enable step; there is no separate Enable button.
SUBTITLE_XML: Import installs the folder; enable it separately with Enable (A).
FD_GUARD: SMAPI uses file_drop: install == enable. Uninstall to disable.
MODDETAIL_FD_NOTE: SMAPI loads every directory under Mods/ that has a manifest.json.
MODDETAIL_FD_NOTE2: To disable, uninstall (moves to quarantine); enable by re-importing.
MODDETAIL_XML_NOTE: Load order / dependencies are NOT solved in this MVP.
MODDETAIL_XML_NOTE2: If a mod needs a specific order (e.g. Harmony), arrange it in-game.
MODDETAIL_FOOTER: Managed by the on-disk journal — persists across QAM re-open.
UNINSTALL_OK: Uninstalled {id}. Folder moved to quarantine (NOT deleted): {q}. Use History → Rollback to restore.
INBOX_SUB:
Inbox: {path}
A = preview / import · B = back. No network, no Workshop.
HISTORY_SUB: A = select txn → Confirm → A/B. Rollback restores the pre-op snapshot / quarantine; mod folders are never deleted.
ROLLBACK_CONFIRM_FD:
Roll back transaction {txn}?
This restores the mod folder from quarantine (file_drop: no ModsConfig.xml snapshot).
ROLLBACK_CONFIRM_XML:
Roll back transaction {txn}?
This restores the previous ModsConfig.xml from the journal snapshot (and the mod folder from quarantine).
ROLLBACK_RECOVERED: Recovered pending transaction {txn} from its snapshot.
RECOVERY_SUB: Unfinished transaction (PREPARED/APPLYING). Roll back to restore the pre-op state.
RECOVERY_SUBTITLE: A = recover / roll back this txn - B = back. The backend never auto-retries.
ERRCODE_SUBTITLE: One code = one friendly message. No traceback is ever shown. Code + log path help support.
MODLIST_SUB: Parsed from each mod's manifest. Missing dependencies / duplicate IDs are highlighted. When writes are allowed, opening an entry offers Uninstall (moved to quarantine, never deleted).
MODLIST_BTN_DESC: Read-only list of installed mods, dependencies and duplicate IDs.
CONFIRM_INSTALL_FD: Install {name} ({uid}) to {target}? (file_drop: unpacking the directory IS the enable step)
CONFIRM_UNINSTALL: Uninstall {pid}? The folder is moved to quarantine (not deleted).
LIMIT_DETECT_ONLY: DETECT-ONLY: depends on the user's ALREADY-CONFIGURED SMAPI install and Steam launch options. If SMAPI is missing or launch options are not set, the plugin reports an error; it does NOT install SMAPI or edit launch options.
LIMIT_COEXISTENCE: COEXISTENCE: if Mods/.mm_deployed or a sibling Mods_Core/ is detected (Amethyst ModManager VFS deployment), the plugin switches to READ-ONLY mode and refuses every write with E_EXTERNAL_MANAGER. It never touches symlinks or Mods_Core/.
LIMIT_FILEDROP_NO_ORDER: file_drop has no load-order or dependency solving. SMAPI itself resolves dependencies at runtime. Out of MVP.
LIMIT_NO_UNIVERSAL: No universal one-click install, no Workshop, no loaders install, no Proton prefix access, no .exe installers, no root, no SteamOS read-only toggle.
LIMIT_GH_COVERAGE: GITHUB COVERAGE: popular mods are often published only on other sites with no GitHub Release, so search will not find a downloadable ZIP. Use the direct HTTPS URL instead.
LIMIT_DIRECT_URL: DIRECT URL: no repository-level trust anchor, so any HTTPS ZIP can be downloaded; whether it is acceptable is decided only by the manifest inside, so read the inspect step carefully.
LIMIT_ORDER_APPEND: insert_mode=append_to_end + load_order_solver=false + dependency_solver=false: ordering-sensitive mods appended at the END may not work. Reordering must be done in-game by the user (out of MVP).
LIMIT_NO_AUTO_RESOLVE: No automatic conflict/dependency resolution, no network/Workshop, no loaders, no load-order editing, no Proton prefix access, no .exe installers.
ERR_E_BACKEND_UNREACHABLE: Backend is not reachable. Reopen the plugin or restart the Steam Deck.
ERR_E_BRIDGE: Communication with the plugin backend failed.
ERR_E_UNKNOWN: An unexpected error occurred. See the log for details.
ERR_E_GAME_NOT_FOUND: The configured game was not found in any Steam library.
ERR_E_GAME_AMBIGUOUS: The configured game was found in more than one Steam library; cannot choose automatically.
ERR_E_CAPABILITY_DISABLED: This action is not available in this version.
ERR_E_GAME_RUNNING: The game is running. Close it before changing mods.
ERR_E_FLATPAK_PERMISSION: Flatpak Steam uses an isolated library path. This build does not manage it.
ERR_E_LOADER_REQUIRED: This sample game does not need a loader. (Reserved for planned games.)
ERR_E_PROTON_PREFIX_MISSING: This sample game does not need a Proton prefix. (Reserved for planned games.)
ERR_E_LOADER_MISSING: SMAPI was not detected. This plugin does NOT install SMAPI; install it yourself or fix the launch options.
ERR_E_LAUNCH_OPTIONS_MISSING: The Steam launch options do not point at SMAPI. This plugin does NOT edit launch options.
ERR_E_EXTERNAL_MANAGER: Another mod manager owns this Mods folder (symlink deployment detected). Read-only mode: install/enable/uninstall/rollback are refused to avoid damaging it.
ERR_E_MANIFEST_UNSAFE: The SMAPI manifest.json is missing required fields or has an invalid UniqueID.
ERR_E_INBOX_MISSING: The import folder does not exist.
ERR_E_INBOX_EMPTY: No ZIP files found in the import folder.
ERR_E_INBOX_UNREADABLE: A file in the import folder could not be read.
ERR_E_PATH_INVALID: The given path is not allowed.
ERR_E_PATH_ESCAPE: The path points outside an allowed folder.
ERR_E_NOT_ALLOWED_ROOT: The target is outside the allowed write locations.
ERR_E_BAD_ARCHIVE: The file is not a valid ZIP archive.
ERR_E_ZIP_BOMB: The archive is too large or too highly compressed to import safely.
ERR_E_ZIP_SLIP: The archive contains a path that escapes the mod folder.
ERR_E_UNSAFE_ENTRY: The archive contains an unsafe entry (link, device, or forbidden file type).
ERR_E_DUPLICATE_ENTRY: The archive contains duplicate file names.
ERR_E_MANIFEST_MISSING: About/About.xml was not found in the archive.
ERR_E_ID_INVALID: The mod's packageId is missing or invalid.
ERR_E_FIELD_MISSING: A required field is missing from About.xml.
ERR_E_DUPLICATE: This mod (same packageId) is already installed. Use Replace instead.
ERR_E_FILE_COLLISION: A folder with this name already exists and is not managed by this plugin.
ERR_E_ACCESS: Permission denied while writing. The location may be read-only.
ERR_E_READONLY_FS: The target filesystem is read-only; no files were changed.
ERR_E_NO_SPACE: Not enough free space to complete the operation.
ERR_E_CROSS_DEVICE: The staging and target are on different filesystems; operation refused.
ERR_E_FS_NO_POSIX: This drive (e.g. microSD/exFAT) has no POSIX permissions; ownership checks were skipped.
ERR_E_ROOT_OWNED: A target file is owned by another user; refusing to change its permissions.
ERR_E_STATE_OWNED: The game state file is owned by another user; refusing to edit it.
ERR_E_STATE_SYMLINK: The game state file is a symbolic link; refusing to edit it.
ERR_E_STAGING_IN_MODS: Staging/quarantine must not be placed inside the Mods folder.
ERR_E_INODE_MISMATCH: Files changed between the safety check and the write; operation aborted.
ERR_E_CORE_MISSING: Core (ludeon.rimworld) is missing or not first in ModsConfig.xml; refusing to edit.
ERR_E_STATE_CORRUPT: ModsConfig.xml could not be parsed; refusing to edit it.
ERR_E_STATE_EXTERNAL: ModsConfig.xml was changed outside this plugin (or by the game on quit). Refresh and retry.
ERR_E_STATE_MISSING: ModsConfig.xml was not found at the expected location.
ERR_E_VERIFY_FAILED: The post-write verification did not match what was planned.
ERR_E_OP_FAILED: The operation failed and was rolled back where possible.
ERR_E_RECOVERY_PENDING: A previous operation did not finish. Use Recover / Rollback first.
ERR_E_ROLLBACK_FAILED: Automatic rollback could not finish. Your data is preserved in the quarantine folder; see the log.
ERR_E_QUARANTINE_FULL: The quarantine folder is full; uninstall was refused.
LIB_SECTION_DESC: Every library Steam knows about, including the SD card. Read from libraryfolders.vdf plus an appmanifest scan; nothing here writes.
LIB_REFRESH_DESC: Re-read libraryfolders.vdf and re-count installed games.
LIB_COUNT: {libs} libraries · {games} games installed · {removable} on removable media
LIB_NO_GAMES: No installed games found. If a library is on the SD card, make sure the card is mounted.
LIB_UNSUPPORTED_NOTE: This game has no Mod adapter yet, so only its paths are shown. Nothing is silently attempted.
MODDETAIL_DISABLED: State: disabled (parked in .decky-disabled/, not loaded by the game)
GH_NOT_VERIFIED: no checksum published by the source
FOMOD_DETECTED: This archive has FOMOD install options.
FOMOD_UNUSABLE: FOMOD config could not be read ({reason}); will do a plain extract instead.
LIB_IDENTIFY_ONLY: Recognition only — this game has no writable adapter; nothing is installed or changed.
NAV_MODS_DESC: Import a local archive; enable, disable or remove what is installed.
NAV_DOWNLOAD_DESC: GitHub Releases and any direct HTTPS link, downloaded into the inbox first.
NAV_GAMES_DESC: Games this plugin can manage, plus every game Steam has installed.
NAV_SYSTEM_DESC: Refresh, history, error codes, recovery and the hard constraints.
GH_FROM_GAME_HINT: Tip: open a game in the Games section to jump here with its name filled in.
MODS_BY_GAME_BTN_DESC: Group the mods on disk by the game they belong to (read-only).
MODS_BY_GAME_BTN_SUB: Reads each game's Mod directory and lists the folders found there.
MODS_BY_GAME_TRUNCATED: (list truncated — more folders exist than shown)
MODS_BY_GAME_SUB_EMPTY2: no mod folders found in any adapted game
MODS_BY_GAME_EMPTY: No Steam games were detected, so there is nothing to group.
DEPS_BTN_SUB: Check which required mods are absent
DEPS_BTN_DESC: Resolve what the installed game is missing and see what can be downloaded.
DEPS_INSTALL_SUB: Fetches only the mods whose manifest matches
DEPS_INSTALL_DESC: A download is accepted only when the zip's own manifest names the same UniqueID.
DEPS_R_OTHER_SITE: only published on a site this plugin does not download from
NEXUS_SECTION_DESC: A free Nexus account can read mod metadata but cannot get download links: the API answers 403 for every file link, keyword search does not exist, and the website sits behind a Cloudflare challenge. So this panel browses, then hands you the page to download in your browser.
NEXUS_KEY_NONE: No key stored. Nexus rejects anonymous requests, so a key is required even to list mods.
NEXUS_KEY_STATE_UNREADABLE: A key file exists but is not private (mode {mode}) or not readable. Save it again to fix the permissions.
NEXUS_KEY_NO_POSIX: This filesystem has no permission bits, so the private-mode promise cannot be enforced here.
NEXUS_KEY_INPUT_DESC: From nexusmods.com/users/myaccount?tab=api. It is written to disk with mode 0600, never shown again, and never sent anywhere except api.nexusmods.com.
NEXUS_KEY_SAVE_DESC: Stores the key locally. Nothing is validated yet.
NEXUS_VALIDATE_DESC: Asks Nexus who this key belongs to. The key is re-read from disk, not re-sent from here.
NEXUS_RECENT_DESC: The API serves three feeds and no search. Pick one; results are live from Nexus.
NEXUS_OPEN_PAGE: Open this page in a browser, download the file, then import the zip from 「Import」.
NEXUS_MOD_ID_DESC: The number in the mod page URL, e.g. nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400 → 2400.
NEXUS_MOD_FETCH_DESC: Reads metadata and the file list. Downloads nothing.
NEXUS_FILES_ERROR: The file list could not be read: {detail}
NEXUS_PREMIUM_ONLY: Nexus gives download links to premium accounts only. This is not a bug and retrying will not help — use the browser page instead.
NEXUS_BAD_ID: That is not a whole number.
LOADER_LOG_LINE: Last launch: {loaded} mods, {packs} content packs, {skipped} skipped
LOADER_LOG_NONE: The game has not been launched since this plugin was installed, so there is no loader log yet.
LOADER_LOG_TRUNCATED: The log was larger than the 4 MB cap; only the beginning was read.
OPEN_PAGE_WHY: This hands the address to the Steam client, which is the browser you can actually see in Game Mode. If nothing appears, the client refused the request -- copy the URL below instead.
OPEN_PAGE_FREE: A free Nexus account cannot get a download link from the API, so use this page: download there, then import the ZIP back here.
SEARCH_SECTION_DESC: The Nexus API has no search endpoint, so this opens the site's own search page with your keyword — that is the only place real results exist.
SEARCH_INPUT_DESC: e.g. automate, chests, HD textures. Up to 64 characters; quotes and punctuation are fine.
SEARCH_BTN_DESC: Opens the browser you can actually see in Game Mode.
SEARCH_FAIL: The search page did not open.
SEARCH_WHY: This hands the address to the Steam client, which is the browser visible in Game Mode. If nothing appeared, copy the address below into a browser.
SEARCH_DOWNLOAD_NOTE: Download the file in that browser, then come back to the import list — it now reads your Downloads folder too.
LAYOUT_WHY_SYMLINK: the mod folder is a symlink, so another tool owns the real one.
LAYOUT_WHY_ENTRIES: the mod folder contains symlinked entries ({names}), which means a manager deployed them.
LAYOUT_WHY_DEVICE: the mod folder is on a different filesystem than the game.
CONFLICT_TRUNCATED: List capped -- there may be more.
QUAR_ORPHANS: {n} quarantine folder(s) can no longer be restored: {list}
QUAR_RESTORABLE: {n} folder(s) can still be restored with Rollback.
QUAR_UNKNOWN: The journal could not be read, so these folders are of unknown status -- not orphans.
